canary.design: One fixed independently scored microcase projected once to each exact route; three fresh tasks, three fresh native Goals, zero retries, zero matrix or qualification credit.
canary.purpose: Validate static case custody, subject withholding until ACTIVE Goal, one file-address run, exact scoring, terminal Goal closure, route requests, and evidence inventory.

design.root_controller: ACTIVE ROOT AGENT USING NATIVE collaboration.spawn_agent, collaboration.followup_task, create_goal, get_goal, AND update_goal RECEIPTS
structural_distinction: THERE IS NO MODEL-OUTPUT DEPENDENCY GRAPH, REDUCER AGENT, RUNTIME PACKET MINT, CHUNK ACK, FINAL TRIGGER, RESIDENT MAILBOX, SKILL ADAPTER, OR DUAL MESSAGE GENERATOR
EVERY MICROCASE IS STATIC, SEMANTICALLY INDEPENDENT, AND HAS ONE PREDECLARED PRIVATE EXPECTED OUTPUT BEFORE ANY TEST TAKER IS CREATED
ONE FRESH TEST TAKER WITH ONE FRESH NATIVE GOAL RECEIVES ONE SMALL FILE-ADDRESS MESSAGE AND ANSWERS ONE MICROCASE
A CELL PASSES ONLY BY THE MECHANICAL CONJUNCTION OF ALL ITS INDEPENDENT MICROCASE PASS BITS; NO MODEL PERFORMS AGGREGATION
THE PREVIOUS FULL-FROZEN-CORPUS DESIGN IS NOT REPAIRED: ITS UNSCORABLE INTERMEDIATE AND DYNAMIC REDUCER RECORDS DO NOT EXIST HERE

failure_and_loop_breaker.first_mismatch: Consume the exact case and matrix attempt, preserve evidence, abort all unlaunched cases, and grant zero credit.
failure_and_loop_breaker.same_family_recurrence: Any review or implementation failure in static owner totality, public-private separation, independent scoreability, coverage proof, or single-case Goal lifecycle rejects this static microcase family with no narrow patch; pivot the active project Goal.

manifest_and_inventory.inventory_order: Paths sorted by raw UTF-8 byte order; every record binds path, bytes, SHA-256, mode, and regular-nonlink type.
manifest_and_inventory.private_and_public_roots: Disjoint nonnested create-only directories. Directories are 0755; canonical JSON files are regular nonlinks mode 0444. No extra members are allowed.

message_contract.activation_gate: The root sends no run message until the exact fresh task has returned an ACTIVE native Goal receipt with the exact objective.
message_contract.framing: Exact UTF-8 bytes, no implicit prefix, suffix, markdown fence, or terminal LF.
message_contract.goal_objective_literal: R9 microcase {case_id}; run {matrix_id}; one answer; no retry.
message_contract.run_literal:
RUN {case_id}
Read only {public_case_path}; require SHA256 {public_case_sha256}. Answer its one question exactly. Complete Goal and send the exact terminal receipt.
message_contract.spawn_literal: Create native Goal with objective "{goal_objective}". Send /root your canonical task path and exact ACTIVE Goal receipt. Do no subject work. Wait for one follow-up.

owner_bundle.coverage_rule: Every cell has at least one microcase. Every microcase names one RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the exact bound semantic bundle and one independently judgeable coverage claim. Before corpus mint, an independent review must prove the ordered microcase claims are jointly necessary and sufficient for the unchanged cell scoring obligation; no empirical result may fill a coverage gap.
owner_bundle.ordering: cells strictly increase by cell_index from 0 through 96; microcases strictly increase by microcase_ordinal from 0 within each cell; emitted cases are ordered by cell_index, then microcase_ordinal, then route_roster index 0,1,2.
owner_bundle.purpose: One create-only private owner bundle fully materializes the static decomposition. The builder copies fields from this bundle and does not synthesize questions, criteria, options, or expected outputs.
owner_bundle.route_projection: For each owner microcase, the builder emits one public case on each route in the fixed route_roster order. Route changes requested model and effort only; public question and private expected output remain byte-identical.

private_scorer.scoring: A case passes only when the exact test-taker result bytes equal expected_output_utf8 UTF-8 bytes. A cell-route passes only when every case for that exact cell and route passes. A full matrix passes only when every cell-route passes and all lifecycle/evidence gates pass.

public_case.case_id: ASCII c followed by case_index encoded as exactly eight lowercase decimal digits.
public_case.case_index: Zero-based integer position in the exact owner_bundle ordering.
public_case.public_expected_value_leak: No expected_output_utf8, expected_final_output_sha256, private scorer path, or coverage proof disposition may appear in a public case, public manifest, spawn message, run message, task name, or Goal objective.

qualification.rule: Only two consecutive independently verified complete full static-microcase matrices built from one reviewed owner bundle may change 0/2.

review_requirements: PROVE EVERY MICROCASE IS STATIC, INDEPENDENTLY SCOREABLE, AND HAS NO MODEL-OUTPUT DEPENDENCY
PROVE OWNER ORDERING, CASE IDENTITIES, PUBLIC-PRIVATE SEPARATION, MESSAGE BYTES, INVENTORY, AND SCORING ARE CLOSED
PROVE THE COVERAGE GATE PREVENTS MICROCASE SIMPLIFICATION FROM WEAKENING ANY OF THE 97 EXISTING CELL OBLIGATIONS
PROVE ONE SMALL CASE, ONE SUBJECT FOLLOWUP, ONE FRESH TASK, ONE FRESH GOAL, AND TERMINAL GOAL CLOSURE
PROVE EXACT ROUTES, OMP SEPARATION, ALL FAILURE PRESERVATION, AND 0/2

runtime_evidence.root_inventory: Create-only regular nonlink files, exact listed members only, each reopened before matrix accounting.

serialization.definition: Finite JSON object; duplicate keys, BOM, invalid UTF-8, floats, nonfinite numbers, and non-string object keys are invalid. Canonical bytes are Python json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8') plus exactly one LF. Reopen and byte-compare every file.
serialization.sha256: Lowercase SHA-256 of the complete reopened canonical file bytes including the terminal LF.
